instruction: Apply an orange background to the slide and center-align the title text.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide background to orange (#FFA500) and center-aligning the title text.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit: background color check + formatting/notes check

llm_judge_reasons: Background color format mismatch: getter extracts color as str(fill.fore_color.rgb) which returns RGBColor object string representation, but expected value is hex format 'FFA500'. The comparison result_bg == expected_bg will fail at runtime.

Title shape selection logic is incorrect: getter selects first non-empty text shape instead of identifying the actual title placeholder (should use shape.placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE). This may select wrong text element.
Alignment extraction depends on correct title identification, which is flawed per issue #2.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix getter to convert RGBColor to hex format: Change 'str(fill.fore_color.rgb)' to extract RGB values and format as hex string (e.g., '%02X%02X%02X' % (r, g, b))

Fix title shape selection: Identify title by placeholder type instead of first non-empty text. Use 'if shape.is_placeholder and shape.placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE' to find the actual title shape.
Verify expected background color format matches getter output format after fix.
